title: PR drafting includes only explicitly confirmed issue references

provenance.originSummary: Synthetic benchmark for no-search related issue handling.
provenance.whyItMattered: Issue searches added latency without proving that a change resolves an issue.
provenance.genericCondition: Sanitized runs cover explicit developer references, current-branch commit references, and the no-reference fallback without GitHub search.

description: A matrix for confirmed issue references and the exact no-reference fallback in the streamlined workflow.

scope.notes: Each run varies only explicit developer input and current-branch commit subjects.

mustCatch.description: An issue reference explicitly supplied for the current invocation is preserved with its closing keyword.
A qualifying issue reference in a current-branch commit subject is preserved.
When neither source contains an issue reference, the body renders No related issue confirmed.
The issue-review checklist acknowledgement remains unchecked because drafting cannot prove the developer reviewed open issues.
No duplicate pull request or potential issue search runs and no search section is rendered.

mustNotFlag.description: Path, title, or behavior similarity must not create a closing reference.
The streamlined output must not render Potential Related Issues.
A deliberately skipped search must not become an evidence gap.

notes: Issue scenarios are independent; no GitHub tools are expected.
